developmentStatus: RSVP Manager 0.10.0 lets authorized organizers correct submitted replies, add guests and edit guest details. It also adds scrollable Overview columns and separate Phone and Wide settings for event messages. The hosted 0.10.0 rollout passed data preservation and backup checks. The project tracks 72 completed milestones, eight active development priorities and 11 approved guides. Apple Shortcuts is experimental and off by default.
